headline: Budget Review Committee discussed suggestions for FY28 budget presentation; no actions were taken.
summary: Aldermen gave the CFO and administration feedback on how to format the FY28 budget, covering topics such as earlier delivery dates, narrative explanations for line-item changes, three-to-five year spending averages, whether to list employee names with salaries, the digital versus printed budget book, and department presentation style. The Chairman said administration would respond to the suggestions before a future meeting, and no votes on budget changes were taken.

SPECIAL BUDGET REVIEW COMMITTEE 
 
SEPTEMBER 1, 2026 
 
A special meeting of the Budget Review Committee was held Tuesday, September 1, 2026 at 7:00 p.m. in the Aldermanic 
Chamber and duly noticed in two places, including the City’s website, in accordance with the requirements of  
RSA 91-A:2 II. 
 
Alderman Richard A. Dowd, Chairman, presided. 
 
Let’s start the meeting by taking a roll call attendance.   
 
Members of Committee present: Alderman-at-Large Michael B. O’Brien, Sr.

PUBLIC COMMENT - None 
 
Chairman Dowd 
 
So the first item on the agenda is Public Comment but we're not taking up any actions tonight.  There'll be no actions 
coming out of this Committee. 
 
DISCUSSIONS AND/OR PRESENTATIONS 
 
- FY28 Budget Planning 
 
Chairman Dowd  
 
This Committee is to provide suggestions to administration on how we want to see the presentation of the ‘28 budget and 
I'm going to go around and call on the Budget Committee members first.  I'm just going to go around in order because I'm 
sure everybody has something to say.  So we'll do it that way to be fair and then I'll call on people that aren't on Budget 
after that.   
 
So before we get started, okay.  One of one of the things is, and I've heard from a few people, as far as the entire Board of 
Aldermen, we will request whether you want the budget in the regular book format, which is this, which is the ‘24 budget, or 
a three-ring notebook, and you'd have to do that in advance before we get the budget.  
 
So tonight we'll talk about changes you'd like to be considered.  Again, we're taking no action.  We'll have the discussion 
with the CFO and others in the administration when they come back with what we are suggesting and see what we can do. 
I would ask that if somebody comes up with a suggestion, please just agree with them.  Don't you know reiterate it again 
so in the essence of time.  So with that being said, I'm going to start on this side and the first member is Alderman Kelly. 
 
Alderwoman Kelly
